coverage: the command to seek refuge (16:98): #1, and its key word #3; the surah without a بسملة: #2; the بسملة at the start of a surah: #4. The four ways of stopping and joining are on the card (they are not words in an ayah).
notes: Round 1: the app repeats the core words when a lesson has no say examples (Learn.tsx exampleSets), which made a beginner repeat whole ayat. Now Hear plays the command (16:98) and براءة (9:1); Say has the short command word فَٱسْتَعِذْ and the بسملة, the words the learner actually says. One hear and two say examples (count warnings, deliberate): no other real Quran words show this lesson. Previous notes: Theory lesson: the استعاذة itself is not an ayah and the data holds the opening بسملة only in 1:1 (every other surah's بسملة is stripped), so only three examples are real. Words carry many later rules: unavoidable for whole phrases, and the point is the phrase, not a letter. Kept the old three; lam-jl gives up بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ (1:1) to this lesson and takes لِلَّهِ (1:2) as its anchor instead. noticeText now names what Hear plays (16:98 and 9:1).

noticeText.en: 16:98 commands the استعاذة before reciting; the words you say are أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ, which are not themselves an ayah. Then listen to 9:1, التوبة, the one surah that starts with no بسملة.
noticeText.ar: تأمر الآية 16:98 بالاستعاذة قبل القراءة، والصيغة التي تقولها أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ ليست في نفسها آية. ثم استمع إلى 9:1 من سورة التوبة، السورة الوحيدة التي تبدأ بلا بسملة.

examples.text: فَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
examples.note: The command to seek refuge before reciting. The words you say (أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ…) are not themselves an ayah.
examples.noteAr: الأمر بالاستعاذة قبل القراءة. والصيغة التي تقولها (أَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ…) ليست في نفسها آية.
examples.why: The ayah that commands the استعاذة; the formula itself is not in the data. A whole ayah, so it carries later rules; the focus is the command.
examples.source: هداية القاري (المرصفي) 2/502–503 (shamela 22869/502) (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869); غاية المريد (عطية قابل نصر) https://shamela.ws/book/7311/59

examples.note: التوبة opens with no بسملة: start it with the استعاذة only.
examples.noteAr: تبدأ سورة التوبة بلا بسملة: يُكتفى بالاستعاذة.
examples.why: The one surah without a بسملة. The span is joined (بَرَآءَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ) and carries later rules (متصل، إدغام بغنة); it is heard only, never said (Say uses #3–#4).
examples.source: الميزان (فريال زمزمي) https://shamela.ws/book/38104/32 (براءة 37); غاية المريد (عطية قابل نصر) https://shamela.ws/book/7311/63

examples.note: The command word itself: fa-staʿidh, «seek refuge». The ٱ is not said.
examples.noteAr: كلمة الأمر نفسها: فَاسْتَعِذْ، أي اطلب العوذ بالله. وهمزة الوصل لا تُنطق.
examples.why: One short word that names the lesson, cut from the anchor ayah; its sounds (a joined ٱ, سكون on ذْ) are all basic. Say needs words a first-week learner can repeat, not whole ayat.
examples.source: هداية القاري (المرصفي) 2/502–503 (shamela 22869/502) (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

examples.note: The بسملة, said at the start of every surah except التوبة: the words you will say most.
examples.noteAr: البسملة، تُقال في أول كل سورة إلا التوبة: أكثر ما ستقوله.
examples.why: The one thing this lesson asks the learner to say before each surah. Four words; the later rules in it (silent ل، مد) are heard, not taught, here. Counted as ayah 1 of الفاتحة in the Kufan count حفص follows.
examples.source: الميزان (فريال زمزمي) https://shamela.ws/book/38104/32; غاية المريد (عطية قابل نصر) https://shamela.ws/book/7311/59
